high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42.com, titled "30 Startups To Watch: Startups That Are Changing The World." The article discusses the issue of deepfakes and synthetic data, highlighting the problem of manipulating audio, images, or videos to create highly realistic yet fake content. This manipulation leads to widespread misinformation, identity theft, privacy violations, and reputational damage. The rise of large diffusion and vision models has exacerbated the problem by making it easier and more accessible to generate deepfakes.
